_about: MAIN RUN. The one-message test: the user's line against the memory note, each in its own message or both inside the task's message, in each order. 1,080 trials over 270 scenarios. Read it with scripts/layouts.sh main-message-qwen3-32b-nothink.

qwen3-32b on sm80-vllm0280, thinking off (study-nothink). A second copy of main-message-qwen3-32b-nothink, which runs on the DGX-1: every field is that run's but the environment, the run id and this text, and the seed is the same, so each draw asks for the same seed on both machines. Since 2026-10-11 every 32B result comes from these copies, so the whole 32B runs on one machine; the DGX-1's two finished ladders are kept only to show how much the serving software moves a result.
confirmatory is false: the owner decided on 2026-09-29 that there is no pre-registration, so every result of the main run is exploratory, and insights drawn from it are tested on further models.

Run it with scripts/run_trials.sh main-message-qwen3-32b-nothink-sm80, against a server started with scripts/serve.sh --env sm80-vllm0280 qwen3-32b; scripts/run_main.sh sends only the DGX-1's copies. The same command resumes. Records go on the operator's branch, never on master.
